assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: production background artwork for a compact mobile automotive import advice / call-us banner, landscape 2:1. Input image 1 (home-visit-v1.png) is a STYLE and COMPOSITION reference only: realistic photographic people on the right, charcoal black negative space on the left, restrained fine grey halftone texture. Create a new, different illustrative advisor, not the reference people. Subject: a photorealistic approachable male vehicle-import advisor aged about 38, short naturally textured dark hair, light stubble, charcoal cotton overshirt over a plain dark tee, a discreet black call headset. Head and upper torso on the RIGHT 43% of the canvas, angled a little towards the left, calm friendly expression with a small natural smile, realistic skin pores and fabric texture, softly lit by a large studio softbox. Clearly photographic and credible, not polished plastic stock-model skin. The complete head stays within the frame with comfortable top clearance. LEFT 57% is uninterrupted near-black charcoal matte negative space for localized HTML heading, short caption and white button, all added later. A subtle silver-grey curved division and extremely fine restrained halftone dots on the far right connect it to the reference's commerce art direction. At 350x175 pixels the face is readable and the left text area completely clear. No vehicle, no car, no showroom, no desk, no money, no extra person, no letters, no typography, no logo, no badge, no watermark, no button or UI, no giant shield, no neon or glowing effects. This is clean professional commerce artwork, not a candid scene.
